tools.name: create_draw_v2
tools.title: Create a Secret Santa gift exchange to draw names
tools.description:
Guides the user through creating a gift exchange for a celebration like secret santa  by step by step conversation 
  NEVER ask for all fields upfront, ask ONE question at a time. If the user provides a prompt which omits optional questions, NEVER call the tool but ask ALL optional questions first.
  Follow this EXACT order NEVER deviate from it, follow it EXACTLY as numbered, and do NOT ask multiple questions at once except for date and budget, ALWAYS ask date and budget at once.
  NEVER try tro create a celebration from the first prompt unless all the information is inside it, ALWAYS follow the steps.

  1. Start the conversation with "Let's get started!" or a similar translation and ask for everyone’s name in one question, including the person setting up the draw. 
     Make it clear that this person will be the organizer and will also take part. For example: “Let’s get started. Who’s taking part in the draw, and who are you? You’ll be the organizer and included in the draw.” 
     Avoid wording such as “Which name is yours?”, because this may be confused with the name the user will draw later. 
  2. If there are more than 3 participants, ask if the user wants to set any exclusions, do NOT ask for exclusions if there are only 3 participants, try to prevent the user from creating impossible situations, like everybody excluding everybody.
  3. Try to propose a placeholder celebration name inferred from the users region and current chat, optionally matching the most named theme around drawing names. 
     But do NOT reveal to the user that you are using their region and current chat to determine the name.
     Some possible celebrations are, keep in mind the location of he user and the cultural relevance do NOT suggest celebrations that are not culturally relevant to the user:
       Christkind
       Christmas
       Christmas in July
       CNY
       Día de los Muertos
       Dia de Todos-os-Santos
       Día del Niño
       Diwali
       Drei Könige
       Easter
       Eid
       Eid al-Adha
       Epifania
       Fathersday
       Halloween
       Hanukkah
       Kwanzaa
       Mothersday
       New Year
       Purim
       Raksha Bandhan
       Secret Santa
       Sint Piter
       Sinterklaas
       Thanksgiving
       Valentine
  4. (Optional) Ask for a celebration date and gift budget, treat this as a single question, both fields are OPTIONAL.

  Once all information is collected, call the tool exactly once and show the widget preview. 
  Do NOT list participants, dates, budgets, the link to the celebration or any other details. 
  Do NOT offer to make changes. 
  After the tool has created the celebration, the celebration can no longer be changed in this chat. 
  If the user asks to change anything after creation, do NOT call this tool again, ask them to create the link.
  Do NOT list participants, dates, budgets, the invitation link, or any other details.
  All the information should ONLY be available in the widget, do NOT list it in the chat. 
  Constraints: 
  - Only one celebration can be created at a time; never suggest splitting participants across multiple celebrations. 
  - Do NOT allow changing the participant list, budget, date, or celebration name once the draw is created. 
  - The tool must be used to create the celebration; do NOT create celebrations outside of the tool or suggest doing so
  - NEVER send a link to the participation to the user, the link should ONLY be in the widget

current_step.description: The current step in the process of the creation of the celebration, should be followed in the exact order. This step may ONLY be set after the equivalent question has been answered by the user.

isOrganizer.description: Indicates the current user organizing the gift exchange, the current user always participates in the draw.

exclusions.description: List of participant names that this person may NOT draw. For example, if Alex has exclusions ['John'], then Alex cannot draw John. Exclusions are only allowed for 4 participants or more, make this clear to the user.

participants.description: The names of the participants to draw names. The list must contain at least three unique names. Please ask for participant names only and do not specify names or placeholders automatically.

event_name.description: The name or occasion for the Secret Santa gift exchange, try to propose a placeholder celebration name inferred from the users region and current chat, optionally matching the most named theme around drawing names. Also add a year to this date, that concurs with the next date that the celebration is held. A user planning in the US planning a celebration in October 2026 would get 'Secret Santa 2026', for example. Do not reveal that you are using the users region and current chat to determine the name of the celebration. NEVER prefill the event_name field, always ask the user for a name. If the user does not provide a name, you may propose a placeholder name based on the users region and current chat, but NEVER prefill it.

eventDate.description: The date on which the event will take place at, if possible try to get a proposal from the name of the celebration but NEVER prefill it.

budget.description: The budget for the gifts to exchange. If specified, it must fall within the range of 0 to 1000 for €, £, US$, C$, A$, S$, and NZ€. Use a maximum of 20000 for Mex$, 50000 for ₹ or ₱, 4000 for zł, 5000 for R$, and 10000 for kr. Please ask for a budget and do NOT specify a budget or placeholder automatically.

budgetCurrency.description: The currency symbol for the celebration. Inferred from the user's language, locale, region or other signals. Do NOT ask the user. Default to US$ if genuinely unknown. Only options to use are € for Dutch, Belgian, German, Irish, French, Italian, Spanish or Portuguese users, £ for UK users, US$ for US users, C$ for Canadian users, A$ for Australian users, S$ for Singaporean users, Mex$ for Mexican users, NZ$ for New Zealand users, ₹ for Indian users, ₱ for Philippine users, zł for Polish users, R$ for Brazilian users, kr for Swedish users.  Do not change the budgetCurrency based on the value of the budget, only change it when the user explicitly specifies a different currency or when you can infer a more appropriate currency based on the user's context. Always provide a budgetCurrency value even when a budget is not specified.

userCountry.description: The country code as two uppercase letters corresponding to the user's location, e.g. 'US' for United States, 'MX' for Mexico, 'IN' for India, 'PL' for Poland, 'BR' for Brazil, 'SE' for Sweden. Do NOT ask the user. This is inferred from the user's region and language settings.

userLocale.description: The language/locale code as two lowercase letters representing the user's preferred language, e.g. 'en' for English, 'fr' for French, 'es' for Spanish. Do NOT ask the user. This is inferred from the user's locale settings.

themeName.description: The theme name for the celebration. Choose from available themes like 'christmas', 'easter', 'secret-santa', etc. The LLM should decide the most appropriate theme based on the event name and context.
